title: Sloped skylight strips
where: all three sawtooth slopes, x=1..5, 6..10, 11..15, z=3..11 (final coords), rows of the weathered_cut_copper slabs/stairs
instruction: Edit build.mjs: after the roof() calls, replace a 2-wide strip of the slope along z (z=3..11) with cyan_stained_glass (or glass_pane) on each of the three teeth so the skylights read on the slope, not only on the vertical steps. Keep stair/slab edge cells.

title: Taller, tapered chimney tops
where: chimney stacks at x=14..16,z=4..6 and x=12..13,z=8..9, y=10..13
instruction: Add a flared cap: ring of upside-down polished_blackstone_brick_stairs around each blackstone top at y=13 is out of height; instead replace the top brick course (y=12) with polished_blackstone_bricks and put a cut_copper band at y=10 and y=7 so the stack reads banded and taller.

title: Crane jib over the gate
instruction: Add a jib arm: dark_oak_fence posts at x=11,y=5..7,z=0 and a dark_oak_fence beam y=7 x=8..11 z=0, with a pulley copper_chain from (8,6,0) down to the existing hoist chain; use mcd paint 'attach' not needed, edit build.mjs.

title: Copper boiler tank by the front base
where: front, x=2..4 (viewer right of the gate), y=1..2, z=0..1
instruction: Replace the 4 barrels at x=2..4 with a horizontal tank: copper_block x=2..4,y=1..2,z=0 with chiseled_copper end caps at x=2 and x=4 and a lightning_rod pipe from (3,3,0) up the wall.

title: Steam vents on the roof
where: tooth tops at x=10,z=3 and x=5,z=11, roof surface y=9..10
instruction: Place a 1x1 brick stub (3 tall) with a copper_trapdoor lid on the roof at those two cells, to read as vent stacks (mcd roof --chimney x,z alternative).

title: Hanging blade sign
where: front-left piers, east end wall x=15,y=5..6,z=0..2
instruction: Use signboard(h,'AETHER WORKS',{at:[14,5,0],face:'north',mode:'hanging',wood:'dark_oak'}) in build.mjs; if no room, B.sign dark_oak with lines 'AETHER','WORKS','OPEN','DAWN-DUSK'.

title: Gear window glazing and cog teeth
instruction: Add 4 more cog teeth at the 22.5-degree angles with cut_copper_stairs, and replace the iron_bars cross with copper_bars so the mullions match the copper ring.

title: Interior boiler and gauges
instruction: Add a copper_block boiler (3x3x3) at x=7..9,z=7..9 with copper_bulb gauges and grindstone valves on its north face; lanterns on fences; connect with lightning_rod pipes to the east wall.

title: Weather the brick
instruction: Run: mcd paint build.nbt out.nbt --rules 'all faces where bricks -> weather light' --face north,south,east,west, then mcd diff build.nbt out.nbt --fail-empty; keep if the sheet reads better.

title: Pipe runs on the back wall
where: back wall z=14 (proud layer), x=2..14, y=3..6
instruction: Add a horizontal copper_block pipe y=5, x=2..14, z=14 with chiseled_copper joints every 4 and two grindstone valves facing south at x=6 and x=11 (south face = z=14); add a vertical riser at x=14 up to y=7.
